note: Kentucky State Parks campground in a wooded hollow beside Paintsville Lake; sites 18-32 line the lake side of the road with the water seen through trees, and a lakeside playground, kayak launch and marina are by the entrance. --Claude
summary: Kept. Fees $40-45 confirmed (RA 2027), winter $32 flat-rate offer noted; hookups now 20/30/50A full (electric added); 32 FHU + 10 walk-in tent, max 48, pull-throughs; year-round confirmed. Lakeview kept (RA flags 7 'Waterfront Site' rows; imagery shows a wooded strip ~40-50 m between them and the shore). Website replaced, phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, kept; contrary operator claim reported): ReserveAmerica marks sites 001, 002, 003, 004, 018, 019 and 020 'Waterfront Site: Y'. On Esri imagery the row (18-32 on the park map) runs along the NW side of the road with a continuous wooded slope between the pads and the shore; the lowest pads near the playground (around 37.8437,-82.8786) are ~45-55 m from the water through trees, and 001-004 are in the entrance cluster further from the shore. No pad is within ~50 m over open ground, so no upgrade.

FEES: the park listing's '$32 per night' flat rate for November 1 - April 1 sits in a sentence welcoming travel workers; ReserveAmerica still quotes $40 for a January 2027 weeknight. nightly_low left at $40; reviewer may take $32 if that winter rate is open to everyone.
Long stays: the park actively welcomes travel workers in winter (state park; nightly sites stay bookable on ReserveAmerica). Not a criteria problem, noted only.
Pin 37.8427,-82.87869 is at the entrance/registration area ~150-200 m SW of the site rows; under 250 m, no move needed (row centroid ~37.8445,-82.8779).
